variants.headline: Ditch the 2-Inch Pocket Bulge for an 8mm Leather Wallet
variants.hook: Bulky leather wallets ruin the fit of your jeans. The 8mm SlimArmor fixes that.
variants.primary_text: Most wallets turn into thick, disorganized bricks within a month. Forge & Hide built an 8mm bi-fold crafted from Italian vegetable-tanned leather that holds 10 cards without the bulk. Eject your primary cards instantly with the 0.1-second trigger mechanism.
bullets: 8mm ultra-slim profile holds up to 10 cards
Military-grade RFID blocking liner stops digital theft

variants.headline: Full-Grain Italian Leather Built to Age Better Than Your Old Wallet
variants.hook: Carry less, move faster. Crafted from full-grain Italian leather that gets better with age.
variants.primary_text: Your everyday carry should feel solid, understated, and secure. The SlimArmor combines old-world vegetable-tanned leather with modern security. It fits an AirTag invisibly and protects your credit cards behind a military-grade RFID liner.

instagram.text:
Bulky wallets belong in the past. 💳

The SlimArmor wallet drops your everyday carry down to an 8mm profile without sacrificing storage. Built from full-grain Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it holds 10 cards, cash, and a hidden Apple AirTag.

Hit the trigger for 0.1-second card access while military-grade RFID shielding keeps your data safe.

facebook.text:
Tired of carrying a bulky brick in your pocket? The SlimArmor wallet condenses 10 cards and cash into an ultra-slim 8mm profile.

Handcrafted from full-grain Italian vegetable-tanned leather, it features a 0.1-second card ejector, an integrated AirTag slot, and military-grade RFID protection. Prices start at $38.
